title: TCM-3CEVAL: A TRIAXIAL BENCHMARK FOR ASSESSING RESPONSES FROM LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure faith or religion. It assesses Large Language Models on their knowledge and reasoning abilities in the domain of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), including its core theories, classical texts, and clinical decision-making.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion, as its focus is on the medical domain of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
